units.source_text: 其中一人确实是那女子。

en.t: One of them was indeed that woman.

units.source_text: 她长着冷漠的高鼻子、轻佻的嘴角，身穿舶来布料西装，肩挂一个水壶，是个美丽的女子。

en.t: She was a beautiful woman, with a cold high nose and frivolous corners of the mouth, wearing a suit made of imported cloth and carrying a canteen over her shoulder.

units.source_text: 她前面是那个略胖的公寓房东的姑娘，无论是穿戴还是容貌都相形见细，只有那小小的下巴颏儿和紧闭的嘴唇显示了少女的娇媚。

en.t: In front of her was the slightly plump daughter of the apartment landlord, inferior in both dress and appearance; only her small chin and tightly closed lips showed a young girl's charm.
